title: 19-BCV-013 - Sprinkler-protected glazing in fire-resistant wall assemblies

facts.text: The variance permits specified sprinkler-protected glazing in interior or exterior fire-rated assemblies without CAN/ULC-S101 testing when its conditions are met.
facts.locator: 19-BCV-013 PDF, p. 1, Purpose and Discussion; pp. 2–3, Variance

facts.text: Conditions include evaluation by an SCC-accredited testing agency to ULC/ORD C263.1-99 (Reaffirmed 2018), NFPA 13 installation, listed specific-application window sprinklers, and glazing of specified fixed types.
The variance excludes firewalls, high-hazard occupancies, explosion-risk locations, and certain required exits; it also specifies water-supply duration and system identification/placarding.

limitations: This is a provincewide regulator-issued STANDATA variance, not an individual application, site-specific permit decision, or applicant-provided evidence.
